headline: Exchange Intake Climbs To 1,240.4 Million Dollars From 853.2 Million, Led By Binance
narrative: Clean-asset intake across 79 trading venues climbed to 1,240.4 million dollars over 24 hours, from 853.2 million dollars at the previous reading. That figure is the change in dollars held on the venues excluding each exchange's own token, so the rise means money arrived on exchanges, equal to 0.449 percent of the 276.1 billion dollars held there. Binance took in 429.7 million dollars, Bitget took in 249.9 million, Bitstamp took in 235.0 million, and Gate took in 190.0 million, while BingX shed 39.5 million.
author: jordan
